product.title: Decision Room (memo exercise)
product.summary: Annotate an analytics memo and name which assumption snapped first.
product.whatStudentsDo: Students work an internal memo: tag two or three fragile assumptions and say where the risk lives, diagnose why the model worked before, then absorb an update where the model's output stays the same but the environment does not, choose a leadership action, and write a decision rationale.
product.technology: Google Apps Script + Sheets with free-text scoring
